text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body will conduct interviews and recommend three candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.

The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Local Appeal Body for a term of office beginning on July 17, 2026, and ending on July 17, 2030, and until successors are appointed: Ron Kanter Trevor Kezwer Gerald Swinkin
